verdict: Organic traffic is growing; five project milestones need to close now.
narrative: This period, your business ran with no paid advertising active on any channel, so all traffic and engagement is coming from organic sources alone. Your website held up well — GA4 sessions reached 7,777 over the last 28 days, with a notable uptick of roughly 52% in daily sessions over the most recent two days versus the prior stretch, all without a dollar of ad spend. Google Business Profile activity logged 596 actions this period, though a 29% dip in the most recent 7 days is partially explained by a data gap on August 31 rather than a true drop in interest. Five planned project milestones — including the Live-Cooking Event Shoot, the Pre-Launch Gate, platform ownership, funnel testing, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — are now overdue, and closing these is the immediate priority so the September roadmap stays on track.
